spec2def(printui.dll printui.spec)

# printui.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/printui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(printui_shims OBJECT printui.c)
target_link_libraries(printui_shims PRIVATE wine libshell32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(printui_shims)
add_cargo_module(printui printui-cargo printui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS printui_shims psdk)
